summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income any payments individuals receive from state-established sovereign wealth funds, provided these funds are permanent, benefit state residents, invest state revenue, and make periodic payments based on residency.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude certain payments from state sovereign wealth funds from gross income, thereby reducing the tax burden on recipients of these payments. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

The bill's sole purpose is to create a new federal income tax exclusion for payments from state sovereign wealth funds, directly reducing federal tax revenue. This revenue loss would increase the deficit, making the topic moderately central to the legislation as a whole.
